svg.text: Waveshare RP2350-Relay-6CH-W. Pins as used by the firmware; check the board's own silkscreen and datasheet before wiring.
RP2350B, 16 MB flash, CYW43439 Wi-Fi + Bluetooth LE
On board: buzzer GPIO23, RGB LED (WS2812) GPIO36, USB-C
Loads: the relay closes COM to NO.
Names and icons are set in Settings.
3V3 and GND from the hub's header feed
Wireless, no wiring: Fogstar BMS, Renogy DC-DC (BT-2), JP diesel heater over Bluetooth LE;
Victron Blue Smart IP22 charger by its encrypted Bluetooth adverts; the 4" display, phones and the
van's head unit over Wi-Fi (the hub's hotspot "Camperlux", 192.168.4.1, or a shared network).
